attempted_reduction: scipy (13.9 MB) and scikit-learn (4.4 MB) arrive as LightGBM dependencies this page never imports; micropip.install("lightgbm", deps=False) does not avoid them, because micropip defers to Pyodide's own dependency graph for distributed packages. Tried and measured.

compression.at_rest: Boosters: 30,823,690 B of model text -> 11,125,154 B gzip -> 14,833,552 B base64, decoded in the browser. Base64 costs 3.7 MB over binary gzip on a first visit and keeps the model off the uncacheable redirect path. Lossless; the equivalence gate proves the decoded model bitwise.
compression.not_compressed: marimo's interface assets are served as marimo emits them.
compression.platform: none — Hugging Face Static Spaces serve files as stored

contrast_with_the_static_page: docs/index.html fetches nothing: 1 request (itself), 0 resources, verified in a browser. At CP-3, marimo export html was rejected for it because it emitted 181 references to cdn.jsdelivr.net. marimo export html-wasm differs in kind: it bundles marimo's frontend with the page and reaches a CDN only for the Python runtime.

cdn.jsdelivr.net.source: Resource Timing inside the worker on cold loads; equals the sum of the 18 per-URL transfer sizes recorded on a cold load
cdn.jsdelivr.net.what: Pyodide v314.0.0 core (pyodide.asm.wasm 3.4 MB, python_stdlib.zip 2.5 MB) and wheels: scipy 13.9 MB, scikit-learn 4.4 MB, numpy 2.9 MB, jedi 1.2 MB, pygments 1.2 MB, lightgbm 0.75 MB and seven smaller ones.

files.pythonhosted.org.what: marimo's own wheels, fetched from PyPI by its WASM bootstrap: marimo_base 1.93 MB, narwhals 0.45 MB, pymdown_extensions 0.27 MB, markdown 0.11 MB.

us.aws.cdn.hf.co.source: server wire log of the CDN stand-in during the same first visit; bytes are the files' own sizes
us.aws.cdn.hf.co.what: marimo's six web fonts and two background images, reached through the static host's no-store redirects (the favicon redirect was not followed).

wasm.marimo.app.what: pyodide-lock.json — marimo's lockfile for the Pyodide build it pins; a marimo-operated endpoint contacted once at boot.

yarden-viktor-delu-day-ahead-forecast.st.source: server wire log of a real first visit (305 direct 200s + 9 no-store 302s of 1,048 B); replaying that visit's requests reproduces the figure byte-for-byte
yarden-viktor-delu-day-ahead-forecast.st.what: the nine boosters as base64 gzip text (14.8 MB), marimo's text interface assets, the row slice, calendar facts, claim set, equivalence fixture and browser_champion.py, the page — and the 302s for nine binary files.

method: First visit to dist/space-wasm served by scripts/measure_wasm_load.py --emulate-hf on previously unused loopback ports (HTTP cache key includes the port): text served directly and uncompressed with an ETag; binary files answered with a no-store 302 (1,048-byte body) to a second origin standing in for us.aws.cdn.hf.co, with a rotating query. Same-origin and CDN-stand-in bytes from the servers' wire logs; cross-origin CDN bytes from Resource Timing read inside the Pyodide worker. Five cross-origin responses carry no Timing-Allow-Origin, so the browser refuses to size them; those were sized out-of-band with HTTP HEAD. The page loaded and rendered completely through the redirects: the identity panel read bitwise identical and all four redirected font families loaded.

platform_serving_model.binary_files: 302 from the static host with Cache-Control: no-store and a 1,048-byte body, to us.aws.cdn.hf.co with a signed query that changed on each of three consecutive requests; both hops send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
platform_serving_model.consequence_for_design: The nine boosters ship as base64-encoded gzip — ASCII text, served directly — rather than binary gzip, which would be routed through the rotating signed redirect on every visit. marimo's fonts and images are binary and unavoidably take the redirect.
platform_serving_model.text_files: 200 from the Space's static host, no Content-Encoding even to a client sending gzip, deflate, br; ETag present; no Cache-Control.
platform_serving_model.verified_on: live public Static Spaces (nanotron/ultrascale-playbook, xenova/whisper-web), read-only, 2026-09-15

repeat_visit.derived_from_headers: In a browser that caches normally: text files carry an ETag on a stable URL, so they can be revalidated rather than re-downloaded; the ~0.92 MB of fonts and images are reached through no-store redirects to a signed URL that changes every request, so they are fetched again on every visit; jsdelivr's versioned Pyodide files are ordinarily cacheable. Stated as derived, not measured.
repeat_visit.why_not: The automated browser used here did not serve this page's responses from its HTTP cache on reload: every file came back as a full 200 with no conditional request, so a realistic repeat visit could not be observed.

revision: Round 3 of this record. Round 1 gzipped same-origin files on the premise that Hugging Face compresses Static Spaces (it does not). Round 2 served every same-origin file directly; a partial Integration review then pointed out that Hugging Face serves binary files through a redirect to a separate CDN host. Both corrections were verified independently on live Static Spaces before being accepted.
self_reference: The Space serves files that print the cold-load size, so an exact byte count is not stable on its own surfaces; they publish two-decimal millions of bytes, which a one-byte change cannot move. The exact figure here describes the final bundle.

totals.plain_language: about 57 MB on a first visit (57,246,862 bytes = 54.6 MiB), from 5 hosts

units_note: Published in decimal megabytes (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes) to two decimals, with exact bytes here.

via_the_huggingface_page.what: Opening the canonical Space link loads Hugging Face's own page, which runs the app in an iframe from the static host. Measured once, read-only, on 2026-09-15 against the already-created Space (then holding template files): the wrapper's document (12,685 B) plus 201 resource entries — huggingface.co 190 requests 953,085 B, js.stripe.com 2 requests 247,693 B, cdnjs.cloudflare.com 1 request 2,955 B, de5282c3ca0c.edge.sdk.awswaf.com 6 requests (sizes not disclosed by the browser), and the static host 2 requests (the iframe, sized inside it). Hugging Face controls that page and it may change; the app's own figures do not include it.
